name: zanker-frontend-inspection
description: Map runtime UI elements to DOM, computed styles, component files and dependencies.

workflow.instruction: Inspect relevant code and find the entrypoint; use component name or route to narrow scope.
If a local app is running, use `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/diagnose.sh --url ... --selector ...` to capture computed layout.
Compare browser evidence with CSS selectors, imports and shared token definitions.
Record source candidates; do not claim precise source map where unavailable.

fallback: If Playwright is absent, use static code inspection and mark browser validation pending.
